|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">地雷の敷設を専門とする、軍用の装甲ドロイド。元来は鉱脈やスパイス鉱山に爆薬を仕掛けるためのものだが、軍用に改造されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm).

'''Card text:'''
May lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to “defuse” (lose) one mine at the same location card.

'''Lore:'''
An armored military droid that specializes in laying mines. It was originally meant to plant explosives in ore veins and spice mines, but has been converted for military use.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is エライン・ヴィーエイテム; the Premiere black-border article reads エンライン・ヴィーエイテム.
